name: Nautilus
description: Captain Nemo's Nautilus from Walt Disney's 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea (1954) at minifigure scale, 106 cm long: its salon windows are LEGO's biggest clear bubbles. Big tiled side panels on hinges, the toothed crest arch over an alligator-head wheelhouse with bubble eyes, the saw keel, the shark's dorsal fin and the fish tail with its propeller and rudder; the port side of the salon swings up like a gull wing on Captain Nemo's salon - his pipe organ, library, aquarium and crew - and the whole ship rides a breaking sea on two clear posts. The salon lights up, the propeller spins and the rudder swings.
notice: The Nautilus design is from Walt Disney's 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea (1954). Unofficial fan model, not affiliated with or endorsed by Disney.
